upcoming_events: Friday, Oct 30 - DU/ICP Community Vaccine Clinic  [12:00-12:30PM – for DU Staff and Students; 2:00PM onwards – for general community] – DU/ICP, in partnership with Walgreens, will host a Community Vaccine Clinic on Friday, October 30, in the school gym. Flu vaccines will be available, including free flu shots for uninsured individuals through Walgreens vouchers. Additional vaccines may be available based on eligibility and insurance coverage.

Attendees are encouraged to bring their insurance card, photo ID, and vaccination records, if available. Female immunizers are expected to be onsite. Staff are welcome to attend and encouraged to share this opportunity with family and community members.
